title: Linkers (although / so)

cards.title: What they are
points: Linking joins two ideas and shows how they relate
A linker is often a conjunction: *because, so, although, but*
Four jobs here — a small set of each

rows: I was tired, **so** I went home.

cards.title: Addition
points: **and** joins two things in one phrase

cards.title: Contrast

rows: I like tea, **but** I prefer coffee.

points: **despite / in spite of** + a noun, not a clause

rows: I was tired, **so** I went home.
